services.name: Snorkel & Sail
services.desc: Only accessible by boat, you and your family can get away from large crowds and enjoy the peaceful serenity of a more private and tranquil spot on our S/V Nova. Come join us on our morning snorkel sail on S/V Nova. We begin by sailing around beautiful Ma’alaea Bay which offers offshore steady winds and calm water. We then sail over to West Maui’s breathtaking Pali cliffs or to a satellite reef off the shoreline of north Kihei for our own private snorkeling spot. Tucked beneath the cliffs are large coral outcroppings that make for beautiful underwater topography and snorkeling. We have a variety of sites along this coast which are some of Maui’s premier snorkel sites including Coral Gardens.

blurb: Guests can enjoy private sailing charters on various boats including sailing catamarans, monohulls, and powerboats. Trips include snorkeling, whale watching, sunset sails, and custom events like weddings and proposals. The company is family-run with experienced local captains and focuses on eco-friendly, personalized experiences away from crowds.
